title: AI Startup Runway Hits $200 Million in Annual Recurring Revenue
summary: Runway AI Inc.’s annual recurring revenue hit $200 million in September, underscoring growing demand from companies using the startup's image- and video-generating software to make marketing materials and ads.

title: Alphabet’s CapitalG Backs AI Chip Startup Celero at $3 Billion Value
summary: Celero Communications, a maker of networking chips, has raised $275 million in a funding round that values the startup at more than $3 billion, tapping into demand to improve the efficiency of AI data centers.

title: Qualcomm to Provide Custom AI Chips to Amazon
summary: Qualcomm said it signed up Amazon.com as a data center chip customer in a deal that gives Amazon the right to acquire as much as $4 billion in shares. Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Qualcomm Signs Deal to Provide Amazon With Custom AI Chips
summary: Qualcomm Inc., the largest maker of smartphone processors, said it’s signed up Amazon.com Inc. as a data center chip customer in a deal that will span “multiple generations” and gives Amazon the right to acquire as much as $4 billion in shares.

title: India Eyes AI Finance Leap After Digital Payments Boom
summary: India spent the past decade transforming how money moves, with its home-grown real-time payments system changing the way millions of people pay. Now, it is preparing for a bigger leap as artificial intelligence reshapes finance.

title: European SpaceX Rival Raises $450 Million to Build Rocket Engine
summary: The Exploration Company Gmbh has raised $450 million in funding to help boost the development of Europe’s first reusable space capsule and a new rocket engine, which the SpaceX rival has said would be the largest in the region.

title: Apple’s $2,000-Plus Foldable iPhone Was a Decade in the Making
summary: Around 2020, Apple Inc. Chief Executive Officer Tim Cook returned from a trip to Asia unusually energized about a new product category: foldable phones.

title: Meta Ran Hundreds of Ads Showing AI Child Sexual Abuse, NGO Says
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. has run more than 300 advertisements on Instagram and Facebook containing suspected child sexual abuse material this year, according to a report Tuesday by the nonprofit Tech Transparency Project.

title: AI Health Company Forus Raises $150 Million at a $3 Billion Value
summary: Healthcare automation startup  Forus has raised $150 million at a $3 billion valuation just months after completing a previous funding round. The Series C round was led by Bain Capital Ventures, a firm that has invested in the company since its early-stage funding. Accel, Thrive Capital, General Catalyst, Redpoint Ventures, BoxGroup and Pear VC also participated in the round, Forus said Tuesday.

title: School Students Who Use AI Get Worse Test Scores, OECD Warns
summary: Students who do not use AI chatbots for schoolwork are outperforming those who do, according to the OECD’s flagship educational report, providing some of the widest-ranging evidence yet that the technology could be hurting children’s learning.

title: Boston Scientific Warns of Financial Hit from Cyber Attack
summary: Boston Scientific Corp. said the fallout from a cyber attack has impacted its ability to ship its products to customers and will cause the medical devices company to miss its sales growth and earnings estimates for the year.

title: SK Hynix and Smilegate Leaders May Have to Sell Assets to Settle Divorce Cases
summary: Marriage breakups get complicated with multibillion-dollar ventures on the line

title: Farmers Are Embracing AI More Than Any Other Tech, McKinsey Says
summary: Artificial intelligence use is surging on farms as growers look for some high-tech help in planning and managing operations after years of scaling back on spending, according to McKinsey & Co.

title: Bluecore Energy Raises $50 Million for Maritime Nuclear System
summary: A Southern California startup with plans to deploy floating nuclear power plants may be one step closer to providing electricity to the busiest seaport complex in the US.

title: German Software Firm SAP Needs an AI Breakthrough
summary: Christian Klein takes a sweeping turn around his office building in southwestern Germany and hits the brakes of his black electric BMW. The chief executive officer of SAP SE jumps out in an ebullient mood, in spite of the circumstances.

title: Amazon Hires Banks for Debut Sterling Bond Sale
summary: Amazon.com mandated banks for a debut sterling bond offering, with the deal expected to launch as soon as Wednesday. The company plans to offer tranches ranging from three years to 19 years. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dyson’s AI Toothbrush Shows How Weird Smart Gadgets Are Becoming
summary: The wearable industry is giving itself an AI makeover that it hopes you like and trust

title: Amazon Hires Banks for Debut Sterling Bond Offering
summary: Amazon.com Inc. mandated banks for a debut sterling bond sale, with the deal expected to launch as soon as Wednesday, as hyperscalers keep raising debt across the globe to fund the artificial intelligence buildout.

title: Circles Group Is Spinning Off Digital Software Services Platform
summary: Singapore-based Circles Group is spinning off its business that provides digital software services to telecom operators.

title: Goldman's Wheeler Says Volume of AI Debt May Pressure Spreads
summary: The sheer volume of AI-related debt issuance could pressure spreads, according to Miriam Wheeler, global head of leveraged finance at Goldman Sachs. "If you look at the last couple weeks in the market on the non-IG [investment grade] side, we have seen some spread widening, particularly in the AI space," Wheeler tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
